answer: A script can invent a name in a millisecond; it cannot invent a decade. Radiographer registration with health council attestation is the decade: three-year degree, 1,000 clinical hours, registration exam, annual renewal. The glacier is the ledger entry dated years ago, made for a purpose that had nothing to do with this epoch. To fake a hundred accounts the ring must stage a hundred such decades, and the ridge in each is the mundane evidence — receipts, visits, signatures, collected one by one. The island is the registry lookup, finished before the applicant has sat down.
